lines.text: A synagogue leader kneels before Jesus, says his daughter has just died, and asks Him to place His hand on her.
A woman who had suffered from bleeding for twelve years touches the fringe of His cloak.
Jesus turns, sees the woman, and tells her that her patience has healed her.
Jesus enters the leader's house, sees the flute players and noisy crowd, and says the girl is not dead but asleep.
After the crowd is put outside, Jesus takes the girl by the foot, and she gets up.
